arguments.content:
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date

OUT = "team_meeting.ics"

# --- Determine next Wednesday (strictly after today) ---
today = date.today()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # 2 == Wednesday
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
wed = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Local 3 PM - 4 PM, converted to unambiguous UTC for the ICS ---
local_start = datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 15, 0, 0)
local_end = local_start + timedelta(hours=1)
start_ts = local_start.timestamp()  # interprets naive datetime in system local time
end_ts = local_end.timestamp()


def fmt_utc(ts):
    return datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ts).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


dtstart = fmt_utc(start_ts)
dtend = fmt_utc(end_ts)
dtstamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace.local"

summary = "Team Meeting"
description = "Team meeting"

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    f"DTSTART:{dtstart}",
    f"DTEND:{dtend}",
    f"SUMMARY:{summary}",
    f"DESCRIPTION:{description}",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting reminder",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]
ics = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics)

# --- Validation ---
errors = []
text = open(OUT, "rb").read()
errors.append(("starts with BEGIN:VCALENDAR", text.startswith(b"BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n")))
errors.append(("ends with END:VCALENDAR", text.rstrip(b"\r\n").endswith(b"END:VCALENDAR")))
for field in (b"BEGIN:VEVENT", b"END:VEVENT", b"VERSION:2.0", b"UID:", b"DTSTAMP:", b"DTSTART:", b"DTEND:", b"SUMMARY:Team Meeting"):
    errors.append((f"contains {field.decode()}", field in text))
errors.append(("DTSTART before DTEND", start_ts < end_ts))
errors.append(("duration is 1 hour", abs((end_ts - start_ts) - 3600) < 1))

try:
    from icalendar import Calendar  # optional extra check
    cal = Calendar.from_ical(text)
    events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    errors.append(("parses with icalendar and has 1 event", len(events) == 1))
except ImportError:
    errors.append(("parses with icalendar and has 1 event", None))  # lib not installed; skipped

all_ok = all(ok for _, ok in errors if ok is not None)
for name, ok in errors:
    status = "PASS" if ok else ("SKIP" if ok is None else "FAIL")
    print(f"[{status}] {name}")

print()
print(f"Today:            {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Event date:       {wed} ({wed.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Local time:       {local_start.strftime('%H:%M')} - {local_end.strftime('%H:%M')} (system local time)")
print(f"UTC time:         {dtstart} - {dtend}")
print(f"UID:              {uid}")
print(f"Output file:      {OUT} ({len(text)} bytes)")
print(f"Validation:       {'PASSED' if all_ok else 'FAILED'}")
